query:
WITH ['CIDR', 'CIDRSet'] as target_kinds
MATCH p = (n :Namespace)-[:EndpointsWithSelector]->(:EndpointSelector)-[e]->(t)
WHERE type(e) IN ['Egress', 'EgressDeny']
AND t.primarykind IN target_kinds
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
name: Cilium - Egress to specific node kind (EndpointSelector)
description: Egress from endpoint selectors to specific kinds (e.g., CIDR, FQDN, etc.). Modify the target_kinds array below to the desired kinds.
